title: Signal Words · Q3 W11 D04
objective: Identify words that show order, reason, contrast, or result in a text.
introduction: Milo is a signal-word spy! 🐱✨ Words like first, because, and so tell how ideas connect.

vocabulary.definition: A signal word that tells which event comes before the others.
A signal word that introduces a reason.
A signal word that shows a contrast.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses the signal word so?

options.text: The blue pencil is on the desk.
I ate a mango for a snack.
The cat sleeps by the window.
It rained, so the plants grew.

items.explanation: The word so connects the rain to what happened next, so it is a signal word.

options.text: The ice warmed, so it melted.
The blue pencil is on the desk.
I ate a mango for a snack.
The cat sleeps by the window.

items.explanation: The ice melted because it warmed, and so shows the result.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses so to join two ideas?

options.text: The gate is painted blue.
Milo practiced, so he improved.
My shoes are new.
The bell rings at noon.

items.explanation: So joins the practice with what happened next, so Milo improved.

items.prompt: Which sentence connects a cause and its result?

options.text: The mango is sweet and juicy.
I walk to school.
The bell rang, so class began.
The chair is made of wood.

items.explanation: The bell rang, and because of that class began — so links the cause to the result.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses a connection word correctly?

options.text: The window is open.
My bag is heavy.
The dog has a red collar.
It rained, so the plants grew.

items.explanation: So correctly joins the rain to its result, so the plants grew.
